description: Shared cases for Query Grid's pagination path-building logic, which exists twice: ItemsRenderer::build_page_url() (PHP, initial render + REST re-render) and buildPaginatedPath()/stripPaginationSuffix() (JS, pagination clicks + browser Back/Forward). Both PaginationUrlSyncTest.php and src/query-grid/test/pagination-url.test.js run every case here against their own implementation -- a case that only one of them gets right means the two have drifted out of sync.

cases.name: page 1 on a plain trailing-slash path stays unchanged
an existing suffix is replaced, not appended to
going back to page 1 strips the suffix entirely
a missing trailing slash on the suffix is still stripped
a missing trailing slash with no suffix still gets one
root path, page 1, is a no-op
